name: Into the Toybox
source:
Welcome to Into the Toybox!

Pietra has lost her bear, and her mother doesn't have time to help her find him.

In a strange world full of toys, can you help her find what she's missing?

[From [url=https://intothetoybox.itch.io/intothetoybox]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《Into the Toybox》！

皮耶特拉弄丢了自己的小熊，而妈妈没时间帮她寻找。

在这个满是玩具的奇妙世界里，你能帮她找回失去的东西吗？

[摘自[url=https://intothetoybox.itch.io/intothetoybox]Itch.io[/url]]
